_meta.purpose: Object<->Process MANY-TO-MANY membership for PSM-FM shared primitives. A transaction is NOT 1:1 with a process; the SAME object serves multiple processes (user principle 2026-06-23). This resolves the high-volume shared primitives (FMX1/2/3, FM5S) into their processes[].
_meta.method: U_USAGE x A_PROCESS x DATA-context: the FM lifecycle (A_PROCESS) gives the native phase; the DATA the executions touch (WRTTP value type, fund TYPE, FM<->PS WBS link) gives the multiple process contexts.
_meta.window: P01 ~2026-02-21..06-21 (RSAU exec volume); FMIOI/detector for data context
_meta.volume_split_principle: An object's raw execution total spans N processes -> per-process share needs the document-level join (which FMIOI doc / WBS / fund-type each execution touched), NOT the object total. The shares below are signal-based approximations, not the audit-log split.

primitives.object: FMX1 / FMX2 / FMX3  (Fund Reservation: create / change / display)

Regular-Budget fund TYPE 001 = 41,949 reservation lines; AVC ledger checks every reservation

primitives.control_note: FMX1/2/3 is hook for THREE custom exits (ZFIX_EF_FUND_RESERVATION + ZFIX_EXCHANGERATE_FUNDBLOCK budget-rate on SAPMKBLD; ZXFMCU17 2%/$2000 AVC tolerance) -> any process touching it inherits those; one of 4 manual fund-mutation paths (with FB01, FMBB, MULESOFT) per INC-000005638.

processes.role: the fund lens every process touches
processes.evidence: fund master display across Budget_Execution / Project_Funding / Donor_XB / Closing; 309 distinct users; INC-000005638 FIX-D fund TYPE 104->106 flip diagnostic

implication: Volume attribution must be per-(object,process), not per-object. The 35,026 FMX1/2/3 executions are NOT 'one process' — they split across Budget_Execution + Project_Funding (4,115 WBS pairs) + Donor_XB (donor fund types) + Closing. This is why U_USAGE x A_PROCESS x DATA is the correct join, not a single sub_area tag.
